_doc: Committed, shared Claude Code settings for the NetSec repo. The PreToolUse hook blocks `git commit` on the default branch (main/master) so changes always land through a feature branch and a PR. The hook fails open on anything else (non-commit commands, detached HEAD, errors). See CLAUDE.md section 2 (branch-first). Personal, machine-local overrides belong in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json.
